source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: This unit may re-roll [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) for ranged attacks aimed at the closest eligible target. When it **declares a charge**, you may opt to use the second part of this ability: it may then re-roll the **Charge roll**, but it must end the move [engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) with whichever **charge target** is closest.

clauses.appliesTo: ranged attacks by this unit targeting the closest eligible target

effects.requirement: finish the charge move in Engagement Range of the nearest charge target
